notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.20.9
Blemish Blaster updated to include Banding Blaster which is the Canon Banding Algorithm from the work of Georg Viehoever (2009-2013, GPLv3)

Updates to Resource Monitor so GPU utilization will work on applesilicon devices and many optimizations to resource monitor. If running manually from github there were requirements.txt updates so be sure to update your venv.

Planetary Stacker has a calibration tab for loading in flats for use.

Stacking Suite updated to include an option to open both dither analysis and the master stacks.

Finally nailed down why python 3.13 and 3.14 did not work for some users. Python 3.13 and newer stopped shipping VC++. SASpro will now look for that and show a message for the user to download and install VC++ if they do not have it.
